leak.oracleIsCeiling: mktOwnOracle / mktSosOracle / mktPlayoffOracle use closing lines from the whole season and are NOT a proposal. They are the ceiling: if the leaky version cannot beat the placebo family, no honest version can.
leak.honestCaveat: nflverse stores the CLOSING line, so even the week-1 line is set about two weeks after his draft. The honest arm is therefore optimistic, which is the safe direction for a null and the unsafe direction for a win.
leak.rosterTeam: Team comes from roster_{year}.csv, a season-level file. For a player traded in October it is the wrong team. Counted below, not assumed away.

variables.mktOwnHonest: Own implied team total, week 1 only (available before the draft)
variables.mktSosHonest: Mean over the full schedule of the opponent's week-1 implied points conceded
variables.mktPlayoffHonest: Same, weeks 15-17 only (the app shows this as Playoff D)
variables.mktOwnOracle: Own implied team total, all closing lines of the season (LEAKY - ceiling only)
variables.mktSosOracle: Mean over the schedule of the opponent's season-long implied points conceded (LEAKY)
variables.ecrVsAdp: adp - ecr. Positive: the experts are higher on him than the crowd
variables.ecrSd: Dispersion of the expert consensus about him

question: Fantasy vinnst a vikulegum vidureignum, ekki a stigum. Halda tolurnar sem eru bokadar i stigum thegar thaer eru maeldar i SIGRUM?

design.schedule: hringadferd med slembadri umferdarod per deild; hvert lid spilar nakvaemlega einn leik i viku

design.arms: medferdin i saeti i, vidmidid i saeti j, oll onnur saeti eftir markadinum; hver fruma SPEGLUD (i<->j) svo saetis-skekkja falli ut og nullprofid se nakvaemt
design.lineup: byrjunarlid vikunnar ur `startersRaw` i src/accuracy.js — ein utfaersla. Headline-frumur skoradar TVISVAR: raunstig vikunnar (`oracleLineup`) og gangandi spa (`wfLineup`, hrist ppg k=4, vikur < w)
design.pool: allir sem eiga vikugogn (QB/RB/WR/TE); taglid a bordinu radast eftir gangandi forgildi thvi features.json ber 145-204 menn en 12x14 draft tharf 168
design.excluded: K og DST — utan draftsins, tom saeti hja OLLUM lidum, fella ut ur mun
design.clustering: bootstrap KLASADUR PER TIMABIL (src/learn.js bootstrapDiff); radir innan ars eru ekki ohadar

q3.question: Bjargar thad ad skipta ur STIGUM i SIGRA einhverri hugmynd sem var hafnad? Maeld breyta: `mktOwnHonest`. Bokadi frambjodandinn er `prevCarG` (README 4d: +23,8 stig gegn placebo-thaki +21,3).

design.treatment: A-Ranking bordid endurradad eftir `z(VBD) + w * z(mktOwnHonest)`, z INNAN STODU fyrir breytuna og yfir hausinn fyrir VBD — ordrett regla `opp-lab.mjs`. Taglid (their sem eiga enga spa) er ohreyft.
design.control: hreint A-Ranking bordid. z-stodlun a VBD er einraen umbreyting svo w=0 gefur NAKVAEMLEGA sama bord — profad lykil fyrir lykil.
design.leaguesPerCellSeason: T x 2 (oll saetapor, spegluð) x runs
design.placebos: 8 deterministiskar sud-breytur gegnum NAKVAEMLEGA sama grid — nulldreifingin er MAELD, ekki formula
design.pooling: osamhverfi lidurinn (E[w>0] - E[w<0])/2 per timabili, medaltal yfir vogir x svid x lognun. Samhverfi lidurinn er birtur ser: hann er thad sem TRUFLUNIN SJALF gerir og hann er ekki merki.
design.ceiling: forspabil fyrir EITT NYTT placebo-fraekast (medaltal +- t * sd * sqrt(1+1/n)) — ekki stadalvilla medaltalsins
design.playerBootstrap: 200 itranir, laugin endursynd MED ENDURTEKNINGU (klonun faer nytt id, sama laug fyrir BADI bordin) a headline-stillingunni: svid `all`, |w|=0,10, badar lognur, oll ar

era.note: adeins 2019-2020 eru FFToday-ar her (vikugogn byrja 2019), svo sa helmingur ber TVO ar og engin vikmork. BIRT SEM SAMHENGI.

real.note: `ppts` = besta mogulega byrjunarlid, vikur 1-14, MED K og DEF

realism.why: hermda deildin ber hvorki K/DEF ne waiver-hreyfingu, svo hun A ad liggja lagra i stigum. Spyrnumadurinn einn er maelanlegur ur somu gognum; vornin er thad ekki (data/weekly ber enga DST). Bilid sem eftir stendur er vorn + waiver og er EKKI fullyrding um hvorugt.

lines: Q1 A-Ranking gegn ADP: jakvaett a SIGRUM i 4 af 4 frumum, marktaekt i 4. Titlar jakvaedir i 4.

Q2 stefnu-rodin: 10-2flex: rho(sigrar,stig)=0.989, sjalfsareidanleiki sigra 0.935 | 12-2flex: rho(sigrar,stig)=0.961, sjalfsareidanleiki sigra 0.947 | 12-1flex: rho(sigrar,stig)=0.979, sjalfsareidanleiki sigra 0.968
Q2 rho(sigrar,stig) er HAERRA en rho(stig,bokud) i 3 af 3 logunum — thad ad skipta um MAELIKVARDA faerir rodina minna en thad ad skipta um HERMI.
Q2 marktaekar stefnur — a sigrum: 0 jakvaedar, 17 neikvaedar. A stigum: 0 jakvaedar, 20 neikvaedar.
Q2 ENGIN stefna slaer BPA marktaekt a HVORUGUM malikvardanum. Thad sem er maelanlegt er hvad ma EKKI gera (zero-RB, QB snemma, WR-WR-WR) — og THAD segja badir malikvardarnir eins.
Q3 `mktOwnHonest` a SIGRUM: osamhverft +0.060 sigrar af 14 (t=0.641, 5/7), placebo-thak +0.354 — bord -0.294.
Q3 skilyrdin thrju: per-leikmanns CI FELLUR · placebo-thak FELLUR · walk-forward FELLUR -> SIGRAR BJARGA HENNI EKKI.
Q3 stigin ur SOMU drofttum: +9.5 (t=0.906) gegn placebo-thaki +42.2 — sami domur a badum malikvordum, sem er thad sem rho(sigrar,stig) 0,96-0,99 spair.
